proof_route: Derive continuity of u -> norm(gradient f(X u)) from C1 and hX.
Choose attained minimum s on compact nonempty Icc 0 T; let m be its nonnegative norm.
Derive actual right derivative of f o X equal to -norm(gradient f(X u))^2 on Ico.
Minimality and nonnegative norms imply derivative <= -m^2.
Apply existing scalar Gronwall K0 with epsilon=-m^2 to obtain f(X T) <= f(X 0)-m^2*T.
Combine supplied terminal lower bound and T>0 to infer m^2 <= (f(X 0)-f_star)/T.
Apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le and return the attained-minimum witness with full comparison.
